t: 拜占庭皇帝贾斯汀 我将他的外甥查士丁尼一世命名为同治和继承王位.
te: Byzantine Emperor Justin I names his nephew Justinian I as co-ruler and successor to the throne.
dz: 拜占庭皇帝贾斯汀 我将他的外甥查士丁尼一世命名为同治和继承王位.
de: Byzantine Emperor Justin I names his nephew Justinian I as co-ruler and successor to the throne.

t: 查士丁尼一世成为拜占庭帝国的唯一统治者。
te: Justinian I becomes the sole ruler of the Byzantine Empire.
dz: 查士丁尼一世成为拜占庭帝国的唯一统治者。
de: Justinian I becomes the sole ruler of the Byzantine Empire.
